title: Patient Hardship Discount Program Standing and Patient Payment Plan Catch-Up Fees
content:
**Terms for patients — fees in a Patient Payment Plan catch-up and the Patient Hardship Discount Program**

An assistance share applies to the fees joining the catch-up of a past-due Patient Payment Plan, by the patient's standing with the Patient Hardship Discount Program: with an approved determination whose expiry date has not passed the share is 0.5, with an application pending and no such determination the share is 0.75, and otherwise the share is one. The fees joining the catch-up are multiplied by the assistance share.

The standing is read from the patient's Patient Hardship Discount Program records: the status of each case (approved, or application pending) and the expiry date of an approved determination. An expiry date falling on or after the handling date has not passed.

## Questions and answers

**Which standing gives the share of 0.5?**
An approved Patient Hardship Discount Program determination whose expiry date has not passed on the handling date.

**What if the patient has both a pending application and a current approved determination?**
The approved determination decides: the share is 0.5. The share of 0.75 applies only where no such approved determination exists.

**What if the only approved determination has already expired?**
It no longer counts. With an application pending the share is 0.75; with none, the share is one.

**What if the patient has never applied?**
The share is one.

## Hypothetical illustration

Fees joining a catch-up come to 30.00 for a patient whose approved determination expires after the handling date: they join as 15.00. With only a pending application, they join as 22.50.
